newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Communists, socialists to meet in Cyprus.
newsitem.headline: Communists, socialists to meet in Cyprus.

text.p: Communists and socialists from around the world will meet in Cyprus on Saturday and Sunday to ponder the new world order after the dissolution of the Soviet Union, conference organisers said on Friday.
The Nicosia meeting marks the 70th anniversary of the creation the Cyprus communist party Akel, the island's oldest and second largest party.
Party chief Demetris Christofias said the conference would be an opportunity for delegates from as far away as Cuba and North Korea to talk about the new world order.
Delegates from 39 socialist or communist parties in 27 countries were expected to attend.
